The problem: direct equality (`==`) fails for floating point sums due to representation error. `0.1 + 0.2` computes to `0.30000000000000004`, not `0.3`.

The fix: use `math.isclose()` instead, which compares with a sensible tolerance (relative: 1e-9, absolute: 0). This is the right tool for comparing floating point sums in accounting codeâ€”and it's part of the standard library, so no external dependencies.
